<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Dancing golden chick</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:244px;height:240px;overflow:hidden;background:white}
canvas{display:block;width:244px;height:240px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xfffdff);
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(244, 240);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

function group(parent, name, x=0, y=0, z=0) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name = name;
  g.position.set(x,y,z);
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}

const chick = group(scene,'golden-chick');
const torso = group(chick,'pear-shaped-body');
const head = group(chick,'head',0,2.03,0);
const eyes = group(head,'eyes');
const mouth = group(head,'bill',0,.235,.452);

function material(color) {
  return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness:.96});
}
const sphere = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,40,32);
function oval(parent,name,mat,x,y,z,rx,ry,rz) {
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(sphere,mat);
  mesh.name = name;
  mesh.position.set(x,y,z);
  mesh.scale.set(rx,ry,rz);
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

const profile = [
  [-1.04,0,0],[-.97,.50,.45],[-.74,.85,.67],
  [-.41,1.09,.85],[.03,1.20,.94],[.40,1.19,.94],
  [.79,1.13,.91],[1.17,1.03,.83],[1.48,.89,.74],
  [1.72,.75,.65],[1.91,.595,.55],[2.08,.504,.485],
  [2.31,.477,.462],[2.52,.425,.408],[2.68,.322,.324],
  [2.766,.162,.17],[2.792,0,0]
];
const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
  profile.map(([y,x,z])=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z)),false,'centripetal'
);
const chestGold = new THREE.Color(0xffb525);
const crownGold = new THREE.Color(0xffdf40);
const lowerGold = new THREE.Color(0xeaa13f);
const belly = new THREE.Color(0xffcb91);
const buff = new THREE.Color(0xffdfae);
const smooth = THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep;
const plumage = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:.97});

function bodySection(parent,name,first,last,offset) {
  const pos=[], col=[], norm=[], idx=[];
  const rings=(last-first)*6, slices=96;
  for(let j=0;j<=rings;j++) {
    const u=(first+(last-first)*j/rings)/(profile.length-1);
    const r=curve.getPoint(u), d=curve.getTangent(u);
    for(let i=0;i<=slices;i++) {
      const a=2*Math.PI*i/slices, s=Math.sin(a), c=Math.cos(a);
      const x=r.x*s, y=r.y, z=r.z*c;
      pos.push(x,y-offset,z);
      const n=new THREE.Vector3(r.z*s*d.y,-r.z*d.x*s*s-r.x*d.z*c*c,r.x*c*d.y);
      if(n.lengthSq()<1e-16) n.set(0,y>0?1:-1,0);
      n.normalize();
      norm.push(n.x,n.y,n.z);
      const color=lowerGold.clone().lerp(chestGold,smooth(y,.15,1.75))
        .lerp(crownGold,smooth(y,2.02,2.58));
      const bibTop=1.55-.36*(x/.94)**2;
      const bib=smooth(c,.16,.85)*(1-smooth(y,bibTop-.19,bibTop+.12));
      color.lerp(belly,bib*.94);
      color.lerp(buff,.35*bib*Math.exp(-((x/.69)**2)-(((y-1.13)/.47)**2)));
      col.push(color.r,color.g,color.b);
      if(j<rings && i<slices) {
        const k=j*(slices+1)+i;
        idx.push(k,k+1,k+slices+1,k+1,k+slices+2,k+slices+1);
      }
    }
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  geo.setAttribute('normal',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(norm,3));
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col,3));
  geo.setIndex(idx);
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,plumage);
  mesh.name=name;
  parent.add(mesh);
}
bodySection(torso,'rounded-breast-and-back',0,11,0);
bodySection(head,'golden-crown-and-cheeks',11,profile.length-1,2.03);

const eyeRim=material(0xb7a13b), eyeMat=material(0x211b0b), glint=material(0x7e7857);
const eyeGroups=[];
for(const side of [-1,1]) {
  const e=group(eyes,side<0?'left-eye':'right-eye',side*.278,.385,.345);
  e.rotation.y=side*.61;
  oval(e,'soft-ochre-socket',eyeRim,0,0,0,.084,.108,.044);
  oval(e,'dark-eye',eyeMat,0,.002,.025,.065,.083,.042);
  oval(e,'reflection',glint,-.013,.032,.061,.012,.014,.005);
  eyeGroups.push(e);
}
oval(mouth,'lower-bill',material(0xe49629),0,-.040,.014,.118,.044,.088);
oval(mouth,'upper-bill',material(0xffc13d),0,.005,.032,.154,.058,.118).rotation.x=.13;

const wingGold=material(0xf5a620), cuffGold=material(0xffba32);
const tip=material(0x503419), tipLight=material(0x694320);
const wings=[-1,1].map(side=>{
  const arm=group(chick,side<0?'left-wing':'right-wing');
  const upper=oval(arm,'folded-upper-wing',wingGold,0,0,0,1,1,1);
  const fore=group(arm,'raised-forewing');
  const sleeve=oval(fore,'rounded-golden-forewing',cuffGold,0,0,0,1,1,1);
  const hand=group(fore,'dark-wingtip');
  oval(hand,'brown-feather-pad',tip,0,0,0,.19,.25,.18);
  oval(hand,'outer-feather',tipLight,side*.084,-.021,-.018,.092,.167,.138);
  return {side,upper,fore,sleeve,hand};
});

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff8e7,0xd9ae82,1.53));
function light(color,intensity,x,y,z) {
  const l=new THREE.DirectionalLight(color,intensity);
  l.position.set(x,y,z);
  scene.add(l);
}
light(0xfff6e1,1.55,-3,6,4);
light(0xffedce,.57,4,3,1);
light(0xffe9ae,.74,0,4,-4);

const ref=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1.63,1.63,1.6033,-1.6033,.1,40);
ref.position.set(-.046,1.225,8);
ref.lookAt(-.046,1.121,0);
ref.updateMatrixWorld();

const grain=`
  {
    vec2 pixel=floor(gl_FragCoord.xy);
    float p=mod(pixel.x+2.0*pixel.y,5.0);
    float n=fract(sin(dot(pixel,vec2(19.41,63.73)))*7351.53);
    gl_FragColor.rgb+=vec3((n-0.5)*0.031);
    if(p<0.5) gl_FragColor.rgb+=vec3(0.018,-0.025,0.004);
  }
`;
const backdrop=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(40,28),new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  depthWrite:false,
  vertexShader:`varying float h;
    void main(){
      h=position.y;
      gl_Position=projectionMatrix*modelViewMatrix*vec4(position,1.0);
    }`,
  fragmentShader:`varying float h;
    void main(){
      vec3 c=mix(vec3(.53,.54,.52),vec3(1.0,.989,.998),smoothstep(-.62,-.10,h));
      gl_FragColor=vec4(c,1.);
      #include <colorspace_fragment>
      ${grain}
    }`
}));
backdrop.position.z=-4;
backdrop.name='white-studio-background';
scene.add(backdrop);
scene.onBeforeRender=(_r,_s,camera)=>{backdrop.visible=camera===ref;};

chick.traverse(obj=>{
  if(obj.material) obj.material.onBeforeCompile=shader=>{
    shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace(
      '#include <dithering_fragment>','#include <dithering_fragment>\n'+grain
    );
  };
});

// Time, body drop, elbow and tip centers for each wing, and eye heights.
const keys=[
  [0,     0, 61,144,72,92,  213,133,213,81,  26,21],
  [160,   0, 31,119,17,73,  180,148,157,99,  22,26],
  [340,   3, 57,155,59,106, 214,146,210,95,  30,26],
  [500,  12, 30,150,24,115, 191,165,185,124, 34,35],
  [680,   7, 32,143,22,106, 190,155,176,112, 28,29],
  [840,   0, 58,145,63,96,  212,144,211,95,  26,22],
  [1020,  5, 31,135,20,94,  186,151,172,114, 28,32],
  [1180, 11, 51,160,46,118, 209,160,208,112, 35,32]
];
const up=new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0);
function point(px,py,z,bob) {
  return new THREE.Vector3((px-122)*3.26/244-.046,
    1.121+(120-py)*3.2066/240+.013*z+bob,z);
}
function segment(mesh,a,b,width,depth,pad) {
  const axis=b.clone().sub(a);
  mesh.position.copy(a).lerp(b,.5);
  mesh.scale.set(width,axis.length()*.5+pad,depth);
  mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(up,axis.normalize());
}
function render(t=0) {
  const phase=((t%1200)+1200)%1200;
  let i=0;
  while(i+1<keys.length && phase>=keys[i+1][0]) i++;
  const a=keys[i], b=keys[(i+1)%keys.length];
  const f=(phase-a[0])/((b[0]||1200)-a[0]);
  const mix=f*f*(3-2*f);
  const v=k=>THREE.MathUtils.lerp(a[k],b[k],mix);
  const bob=v(1)*3.2066/240;
  chick.position.y=-bob;
  for(let j=0;j<2;j++) {
    const e=eyeGroups[j];
    e.position.y=point(0,v(10+j),e.position.z,bob).y-head.position.y;
    const {side,upper,fore,sleeve,hand}=wings[j];
    const k=2+4*j;
    const inward=THREE.MathUtils.clamp((108-Math.abs(v(k+2)-124))/60,0,1);
    const shoulder=new THREE.Vector3(side*.82,1.40,.11);
    const elbow=point(v(k),v(k+1),.38+.29*inward,bob);
    const wrist=point(v(k+2),v(k+3),.51+.48*inward,bob);
    segment(upper,elbow,shoulder,.29,.31,.21);
    fore.position.copy(elbow);
    const axis=wrist.clone().sub(elbow);
    segment(sleeve,new THREE.Vector3(),axis,.235+.064*inward,.28,.15);
    hand.position.copy(axis);
    hand.position.z+=.10;
    hand.rotation.z=side*(.45-.97*inward);
    hand.scale.set(.83+.30*inward,1,1);
  }
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
}
render(0);
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters:[chick],render,ready:true};
</script>
</body>
</html>
